bat-cmd-mp4-crf: cd /d "C:\Input\" &&  for %f in (*.mov) do (echo) & for /F "delims=" %A in ('@ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream^=bit_rate -of default^=noprint_wrappers^=1:nokey^=1 "%~f" 2^>^&1') do (SET aBitRate=%A) & for /F %A in ('echo %aBitRate%') do (echo) & (IF %A EQU N/A (SET aBitRate=320000)) & (IF %A EQU "" (SET aBitRate=320000)) & for /F %A in ('echo %aBitRate%') do (echo) & (IF %A gtr 400000 (SET aBitRate=400000) ELSE (echo BitRate within AAC Limit of 400k)) & for /F %A in ('echo %aBitRate%') do (echo) && ffmpeg -y -i "C:\Input\%f" -c:v libx264 -preset medium -b:v 4000K -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v baseline -level 3.0 -movflags +faststart -vf "scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2" -map 0:v:0? -c:a aac -q:a 2 -map 0:a:0? -c:s mov_text -map 0:s? -map_chapters 0 -map_metadata 0 -f mp4 -threads 0 "C:\Output\%~nf.mp4"
bat-cmd-mkv-1pass: cd /d "C:\Input\" &&  for %f in (*.mkv) do (echo) & for /F "delims=" %A in ('@ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream^=bit_rate -of default^=noprint_wrappers^=1:nokey^=1 "%~f" 2^>^&1') do (SET aBitRate=%A) & for /F %A in ('echo %aBitRate%') do (echo) & (IF %A EQU N/A (SET aBitRate=320000)) & (IF %A EQU "" (SET aBitRate=320000)) & for /F %A in ('echo %aBitRate%') do (echo) & (IF %A gtr 640000 (SET aBitRate=640000) ELSE (echo BitRate within AC3 Limit of 640k)) & for /F %A in ('echo %aBitRate%') do (echo) && ffmpeg -y -i "C:\Input\%f" -c:v libx264 -preset medium -b:v 4000K -minrate 4000K -maxrate 4000K -bufsize 8000K -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v baseline -level 3.0 -movflags +faststart -vf "scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2" -map 0:v? -c:a ac3 -b:a %A -map 0:a:0? -c:s ass -map 0:s? -map_chapters 0 -map_metadata 0 -f matroska -threads 0 "C:\Input\%~nf.mkv"
bat-ps-mp4-audio-auto: $files = Get-ChildItem "C:\Input" -Filter *.mov; foreach ($f in $files) {$fullName = $f.FullName; $inputName = $f.Name; $outputName = (Get-Item $fullName).Basename; $aBitrate = & ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream=bit_rate -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 `"$fullName`"; if (!$aBitrate) { $aBitrate = 0}; if ($aBitrate -gt 400000) { $aBitrate = 400000 }; ffmpeg -y -i "C:\Input\$inputName" -c:v libx264 -preset medium -b:v 4000K -minrate 4000K -maxrate 4000K -bufsize 8000K -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v baseline -level 3.0 -movflags +faststart -vf "scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2" -map 0:v:0? -c:a aac -q:a 2 -map 0:a:0? -c:s mov_text -map 0:s? -map_chapters 0 -map_metadata 0 -f mp4 -threads 0 "C:\Output\$outputName.mp4" }
